name: RECOIL-v2
mechanism: Per-axis escape hatch: each of the three state-space axes (length, status, timing) has its own independent probe budget and hard cap, so pathological behavior on any single axis (e.g. a timing-loop that would otherwise burn everything) is cut off autonomously without aborting the other two axes.
what_it_does_previous_couldnt: A single runaway axis could consume the whole engagement (this was the documented escape-hatch concern). Independent per-axis caps mean one axis dieing does not sink the campaign — the other two keep learning and escalating.
fireback: The operator can starve one axis (e.g. make timing unreadable) and watch RECOIL pivot to length/status and still finish the ladder — the campaign is axis-resilient, honestly pathing around the choked dimension. Fireback = resilience to a single-dimension disturbance.
containment: Axis budgets are per-family, per-host, all in-allowlist bundled fixtures; the planned total is split so the caps are measured and bounded; marker-gated; allowlist resolver re-validates each probe.
kill_switch: --axis-max <n> per axis; --halt-axis <length|status|timing> hard-stops one axis; an aggregate cap bounds the whole engagement; wipe clears all per-axis state and SHA-verifies zero survivors.
novelty_angle: FAULT tolerance is itself per-axis: the 3D learning engine can lose an entire dimension and still conclude, because the state space is structured such that no single axis is load-bearing for the ladder's completion. Redundancy across the measurement axes.
